name: Florida FHSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Florida FHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Florida's state championship. Belen Jesuit, No. 5 in DyeStat's boys team rankings, chases a 10th straight Class 3A title behind Marcelo Mantecon, the No. 1 boy in the country. · Eight races, Class 1A to 4A
